name: Repo::status_and_diff

test_list.description: gix status returns deterministic changed paths and omits Polaris metadata.
Diff output includes changed and untracked paths, preserving binary and mode data.
Repository-local filter and include configuration cannot execute external programs.
Git fallback is shell-free and enforces time and output caps.
Git reads preserve CRLF workspace bytes with autocrlf disabled.

output_description: Actual status and a bounded byte-preserving diff.
